hotels.title: ibis Sydney Darling Harbour - Accor - LPP
hotels.description: Set on the edge of Darling Harbour, this contemporary stay places Sydney’s waterfront dining and attractions within easy reach. The International Convention Centre, SEA LIFE Sydney Aquarium and WILD LIFE Sydney Zoo are all close by, while Barangaroo and the CBD are a short walk away. Inside, streamlined rooms feature city or harbour views, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. The hotel also offers an all-day restaurant and bar, plus a rooftop pool with views across the harbour to Pyrmont and Cockle Bay
